coreClaim: Conversation and Roleplay users can run /illustrate with optional invisible free-form art direction, and De-Koi carries that guidance through the existing manual Illustrator prompt and deterministic fallback without persisting a chat message.

inScope: Conversation and Roleplay input dispatch to the existing manual Illustrator retry
Transient prompt guidance and XML delimiter escaping
Selected-message fallback preservation of optional guidance
outOfScope: Automatic Illustrator cadence and significance decisions
Image provider transport, model selection, and image quality
Message-number targeting and saved art-direction presets
Storage schemas, Rust commands, and remote-runtime routes

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The new command privately targets the latest visible assistant response and uses optional trailing text only as art direction for that manual illustration request.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt assembly and cross-entrypoint generation routing
entrypoints: Shared ChatInput slash-command submission for Roleplay
legacyPathsOrFormats: Selected-message fallback after repeated declined or unusable Illustrator responses
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not alter provider behavior or promise a specific image quality.
This change does not add guidance to automatic Illustrator runs.
This change does not make /illustrate available in Game mode.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: De-Koi had a manual message paintbrush action but no typed slash command capable of privately forwarding arbitrary user art direction into that existing scene-aware pipeline.
contractLaneGate.producer: The slash-command registry parses optional trailing guidance and dispatches the latest assistant message ID through a narrow injected action.
contractLaneGate.consumer: The generation retry orchestrator, agent runner, and Illustrator executor consume the manual flag and optional guidance to build the image prompt.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: Slash guidance must remain invisible, stay scoped to one manual request, preserve current scene facts, survive fallback, and never corrupt prompt delimiters.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Both input owners adapt SlashCommandContext.illustrate to retryAgents; start-generation trims the option; agent-runner stores it only in current-run context; agent-executor XML-escapes it; the deterministic fallback appends it to the selected-message prompt.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: src/shared/lib/slash-commands.ts owns command semantics; src/engine owns generation and prompt behavior; React inputs only inject retryAgents.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not persist a synthetic hidden user message, add a second image pipeline, or duplicate prompt construction in React mode inputs.
regressionProof: The slash-command test failed before registration and passed after, proving arbitrary trimmed guidance, no createMessage call, no normal generate call, guidance-free behavior, no-target feedback, help, and autocomplete.
The public retry test failed before the guidance handoff and passed after, proving escaped prompt content reaches the existing Illustrator request.
The fallback test failed when guidance was dropped and passed after manualIllustratorFallbackPrompt preserved it.

positiveRows.claim: /illustrate forwards arbitrary optional art direction without creating a transcript message.
positiveRows.evidence: slash-commands.spec.ts executes the matched command, observes the exact trimmed callback payload, and asserts createMessage and generate were not called.

positiveRows.claim: Guidance reaches the scene-aware manual Illustrator prompt safely.
positiveRows.evidence: start-generation.retry-agents.spec.ts observes the selected conversation context and an XML-escaped user_illustration_guidance element before image generation.

positiveRows.claim: Guidance survives the deterministic selected-message fallback.
positiveRows.evidence: The fallback integration row forces unusable Illustrator responses and observes both the selected assistant content and requested overhead camera angle in the image prompt.

contradictionRows.claim: A chat with no assistant scene must not trigger an illustration.
contradictionRows.evidence: The slash-command test receives ephemeral no-scene feedback and observes no illustrate callback.

contradictionRows.claim: Hostile delimiter-shaped guidance must not close the prompt element.
contradictionRows.evidence: The integration row supplies a literal closing tag plus ampersand and quotes, then observes escaped entities and confirms the raw string is absent.

contradictionRows.claim: Guidance-free /illustrate must preserve existing paintbrush behavior.
contradictionRows.evidence: The command test forwards only forMessageId, while all existing manual Illustrator retry tests remain green.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing manual message paintbrush and selected-message fallback paths remain intact.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: The complete manual Illustrator retry describe block passes, including upstream manual-context repair and gallery attachment rows.

untestedRows: No live image-provider request was created solely for pre-merge verification; exact-build Pi deployment is non-destructive and does not create user content.

ownedFacts.description: Conversation and Roleplay slash-command inputs both use the same retryGenerationAgents Illustrator path.
ownedFacts.evidence: Derived from ConversationInput.tsx, ChatInput.tsx, use-generate.ts, and start-generation.ts.

ownedFacts.description: The transient _illustratorGuidance field has one current-run write site and one prompt read site, with no storage write site.
ownedFacts.evidence: Repository search for _illustratorGuidance returns only agent-runner.ts and agent-executor.ts.

steps: Execute matchSlashCommand with /illustrate followed by arbitrary guidance.
Observe that the command is absent before the change and cannot dispatch the manual Illustrator action.
Execute retryGenerationAgents with illustratorGuidance and inspect the resulting Illustrator prompt.
beforeEvidence: The focused slash-command suite failed all four rows because /illustrate was not registered.
The focused engine row failed because the expected user_illustration_guidance prompt element was absent.
The fallback row failed because the generated image prompt omitted the requested camera angle.

riskClaimMatrix.riskType: prompt assembly and cross-entrypoint generation routing
